proof_scope: Live $memory seeding of literal C0/C1 evaluation records for the preregistered matched experiment, with exact reread per record.

claims.proves: The C0/C1 evaluation arm records can be seeded into live persona_memory as literal-experience records (admissible shape, canonical event ids, arm-scoped keys) and exactly reread, idempotently.
claims.does_not_prove: That admission accepts any delta, that state evolves, that behavior or delivery changes, or that a human perceived anything.

capability_claims.description: Arm-subset seeding upserts literal records and exact-rereads every one; reseeding without reset is idempotent.

out_of_scope_claims: No claim about delta admission, state evolution, or delivery change belongs to this fixture.

cases.name: c0c1-seed-full-exact-reread
cases.description: Seed every C0/C1 record (all arms and controls) with --reset and prove exact reread of each.
command:
D=/tmp/pd-c0c1-seed; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; bash ../run.sh seed-c0c1-eval-memory --arm full --reset --receipt "$D/receipt.json" --json >/dev/null && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
r = json.load(open('/tmp/pd-c0c1-seed/receipt.json'))
assert r['status'] == 'PASS_C0C1_EVAL_MEMORY_SEEDED', r
assert r['live'] is True and r['mocked'] is False, r
assert r['arm'] == 'full' and r['record_count'] == 12, r
assert all(x['exact_reread'] for x in r['exact_rereads']), r
assert len(r['seeded_keys']) == 12, r
print('PASS_C0C1_SEED_FULL_EXACT_REREAD')
PY
expected_notes: every record exact-reread with no field mismatch

cases.name: c0c1-seed-idempotent-without-reset
cases.description: Reseeding the full arm WITHOUT --reset must not change the persona tag record count (append-only memory; upsert overwrite, no duplicates).
command:
D=/tmp/pd-c0c1-seed2; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; bash ../run.sh seed-c0c1-eval-memory --arm full --receipt "$D/r1.json" --json >/dev/null && B=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$D/r1.json'))['persona_tag_count_after'])") && bash ../run.sh seed-c0c1-eval-memory --arm full --receipt "$D/r2.json" --json >/dev/null && python3 - "$B" <<'PY'
import json, sys
before = int(sys.argv[1])
r = json.load(open('/tmp/pd-c0c1-seed2/r2.json'))
assert r['status'] == 'PASS_C0C1_EVAL_MEMORY_SEEDED', r
assert all(x['exact_reread'] for x in r['exact_rereads']), r
assert r['persona_tag_count_before'] == before, (before, r['persona_tag_count_before'])
assert r['persona_tag_count_after'] == before, (before, r['persona_tag_count_after'])
print('PASS_C0C1_SEED_IDEMPOTENT')
PY
expected_notes: persona tag record count identical before and after reseed (no duplicates created)
proves append-only memory tolerates reseeding without drift
